audit_status: discovery + diagnosis complete, no files modified

issues.problem: Homepage hierarchy is inverted: 14 supplementary cards (6 atlases + 5 guides + 3 build-think-study) sit between Featured Projects (3 cards) and About. The strongest 60 words on the site (Master of AI, Perplexity AI fellow) appear at line 550 of 838, after a wall of secondary content.
issues.evidence: index.html sections: hero (185) → projects (239) → atlases (321) → guides (421) → build-think-study (508) → about (550) → experience (620) → contact (745).
issues.recommended_fix: Cut Guides + Build-Think-Study sections from homepage entirely. Reduce Atlases section from 6 to 3 cards with a 'See all atlases' link. Move About above Atlases.

issues.problem: Primary nav has 8 top-level slots + 2 dropdowns with 11 sub-items + 19 flat items on mobile. A first-time visitor has to make 8 decisions in the first 5 seconds and the mobile menu fills the viewport.
issues.recommended_fix: Collapse to 5 top-level items: Work · Writing · Atlases · About · Contact. Mobile menu becomes 5 collapsible groups.

issues.problem: Off-brand for an AI engineer's personal site. ~977 lines on peptide science, biohacking hype, safety. Dilutes positioning and confuses the keyword profile.
issues.evidence: peptides/index.html, in primary Guides dropdown (line 140 of index.html).
issues.recommended_fix: Remove from primary nav. Either delete the file, add `<meta name="robots" content="noindex">`, or convert the best parts into one blog post.

issues.problem: Off-brand for an AI engineer's personal site. 705 lines on epistemology, bias, belief framework. Useful but doesn't differentiate the brand and competes with peptides for tangential-content space.
issues.evidence: scientific-process/index.html, in primary Guides dropdown (line 135 of index.html).
issues.recommended_fix: Remove from primary nav. Convert to a blog post or delete.

issues.problem: Page is structural skeleton (categories, no actual notes). It's wired into primary nav and homepage as if it were a body of work, but the content does not exist yet.
issues.recommended_fix: Move to /about/notes/ and remove from primary nav until 10+ real notes are written.

issues.problem: Library page is mostly skeleton. 'Six shelves, twelve seed resources' but the resources are thin. Promises more than delivers.
issues.recommended_fix: Move to /about/reading/ and demote from primary nav.

issues.problem: Hero tagline is passive AI-portfolio template: 'I build intelligent systems, from foundation models and LLM pipelines to real-world AI tools.' Does not differentiate the visitor.
issues.recommended_fix: Rewrite to a sharper sentence anchored in role + proof. See 04-content-positioning-audit.md for drafts.

issues.problem: Three about-stat counters ('5+ Models Trained', '92% AUROC', '3 Production Tools') are vague or under-supported. '5+' is loose, '92%' is one project, '3 tools' is small.
issues.recommended_fix: Replace counters with 4 factual chips: '45 essays · Master of AI, Monash · Business Fellow, Perplexity AI · 50-paper atlas'. No animation.

issues.problem: 4 of 14 atlas / guide pages do not include the global nav header. A visitor inside these pages cannot return to Projects / Home / Contact via the header.
issues.evidence: grep '<a href="../projects/">' across atlas indexes returns 0 for these 4 pages.
issues.recommended_fix: Add the standard `<nav class="nav">` block to each of the 4 pages.

issues.problem: Hero offers 4 equal-weight CTAs (GitHub / LinkedIn / Email / Resume). No primary action emerges. Visitor decision is diffused.
issues.recommended_fix: Reduce to 2 CTAs: primary 'Read essays' (or 'See projects'), secondary 'Contact'. Move GitHub / LinkedIn / Resume to footer or About.

issues.problem: Sitemap drift: lists `hello-world` (no such file), missing `no-alexander-without-aristotle` and `the-title-was-wrong` (both exist on disk).
issues.evidence: diff between `ls blog/posts/*.html` and `grep blog/posts/ sitemap.xml`.
issues.recommended_fix: Remove the hello-world block; add `<url>` blocks for the 2 missing posts. Regenerate from `blog/posts.json` going forward.

issues.problem: Both pages are missing `<link rel="canonical">` in `<head>`.
issues.recommended_fix: Add `<link rel="canonical" href="https://pugalenthimagendran.com/accelerated-computing-atlas/">` and equivalent for the consulting map.

issues.problem: No skip-link anywhere. First focusable element on every page is the nav logo, followed by 8-19 menu items. Keyboard / screen-reader users have no fast path to main content.
issues.evidence: grep for skip-link / skip-to-content returns nothing across project files.
issues.recommended_fix: Add `Skip to content` as first child of body, with CSS to position it off-screen until focused.

issues.problem: Mobile menu is a 19-item flat list with span-based section dividers (not proper headings or buttons). Section dividers are not part of nav landmarks.
issues.recommended_fix: Re-organise into 5 collapsible groups using proper buttons/details elements. Combine with nav cleanup in Phase 3.

issues.problem: Two marquee strips of tech buzzwords ('Python · PyTorch · LLMs · …') below the hero. Decorative noise; same content available in the Skills tag grid in About.
issues.recommended_fix: Remove both marquees from homepage.

issues.problem: Four always-on decorative layers: custom cursor + grain overlay + mouse-glow + (homepage only) particle canvas. On low-end devices the combination causes jank.
issues.evidence: index.html lines 60-73; style.css cursor/grain/mouse-glow rules; script.js particle canvas at ~ line 1060.
issues.recommended_fix: Keep grain + cursor. Drop mouse-glow + particle canvas on mobile. Gate everything on prefers-reduced-motion.

issues.problem: Global nav and footer are hardcoded into 60+ HTML files. Any nav restructure requires touching every page.
issues.recommended_fix: Either introduce a tiny build step (eleventy / 11ty, or a 30-line shell script) for HTML includes, or accept the duplication and use a careful find-and-replace approach for nav changes.

issues.problem: 3105-line stylesheet with no spacing scale, no type scale, 14 distinct z-index values, hardcoded hex colours, 5 parallel card styles, 5 button styles, and 20+ keyframes.
issues.recommended_fix: Phase 4 design-system refactor. Add spacing scale, type scale, z-index scale; consolidate card and button patterns; audit and remove dead keyframes.

issues.problem: Each blog post embeds ~10 KB of repeated essay-base CSS in `<head>`. 45 essays × 10 KB ≈ 450 KB of duplicated CSS over the blog.
issues.evidence: Cross-check the `.essay-format / .essay-page / .essay-hed / .essay-deck` rules at the top of every post.
issues.recommended_fix: Extract `blog/essay-base.css` containing the shared base. Each post keeps only its per-essay scoped CSS inline.

issues.problem: Largest page on site: 1948 lines, 14 scripts, 9 stylesheets. Lots of layer-specific JS / CSS loaded eagerly.
issues.recommended_fix: Lazy-load layer JS / CSS as the user opens layers, or split into per-layer subpages.

issues.problem: Blog index renders 45 posts client-side from posts.json. `<noscript>` fallback only shows a generic message; it does not list the 45 post URLs statically.
issues.recommended_fix: Inside `<noscript>`, render a static `<ul>` of 45 `<a>` links to each post. Either inline at build time or via a tiny generator script.

issues.problem: Four Coursera specialisation cards (Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, Google Data Analytics) read as junior credentials next to a Master of AI from Monash + a Perplexity fellowship.
issues.recommended_fix: Compress to a single line: 'Coursera specialisations in ML / DL / NLP / Data Analytics, 2023-2024.' Or remove the certs block entirely.

issues.problem: Timeline-dot reveal animation hardcodes delays for items 1-3 only. The 4th timeline item (VC Analyst) is built but its dot does not animate.
issues.recommended_fix: Replace hardcoded delays with `forEach((dot, idx) => dot.style.animationDelay = `${0.3 + idx * 0.5}s`)`.

issues.problem: Contact form success state injects inline `style.background` / `style.boxShadow` rather than toggling a CSS class.
issues.recommended_fix: Add `.btn--success` class in style.css; toggle the class.

issues.problem: Reading Room is filed under Atlases dropdown but it's a library, not an atlas. Misclassified.
issues.evidence: index.html line 110 (Reading Room under Atlases dropdown).
issues.recommended_fix: Move Reading Room out of Atlases. Under new IA it lives under /about/reading/.

issues.problem: Footer carries 16 links but is inconsistent with header. Footer omits AI Questions, AI Knowledge Bank, Peptides, AI Field Manual while header includes them.
issues.recommended_fix: Restructure footer as 4-column grouped layout matching new IA (Work / Writing / Atlases / About).

issues.problem: Preloader runs 1.6 s on first visit. Artificial delay before First Contentful Paint.
issues.recommended_fix: Either shorten to 600-800 ms or tie duration to actual asset load (`window.addEventListener('load', …)`).

issues.problem: Container width alternates between 800 px (`.container`) and 1100 px (`.container-wide`) section to section, causing left-right visual rhythm bounce.
issues.evidence: Hero narrow, projects wide, atlases wide, guides wide, build wide, about narrow, experience narrow, contact narrow.
issues.recommended_fix: Standardise container width per section type. Either everything 1100 px on a wide layout or alternate intentionally.

issues.problem: `.nav-dropdown-menu` has `role="menu"` and children have `role="menuitem"`, but the JS handles only hover and click, not arrow keys. WAI-ARIA menu pattern implies keyboard navigation.
issues.evidence: index.html line 84; script.js atlas dropdown init.
issues.recommended_fix: Either implement arrow-key navigation, or remove the `role="menu"` and treat as a plain disclosure widget.

issues.problem: Mobile nav row height ~ 24-32 px. WCAG 2.5.5 AAA requires 44×44 CSS px tap targets.
issues.recommended_fix: Bump min-height to 48 px on `.nav-mobile a`.

issues.problem: Page `<title>` is 90 characters: 'The Scientific Process: Humanity's Best Tool for Finding Truth | Pugalenthi Magendran'. Recommendation is ≤ 60.
issues.recommended_fix: Trim to 'The Scientific Process | Pugalenthi Magendran' or similar.

issues.problem: Footer brand line 'Building intelligent systems.' duplicates and weakens the hero tagline ('I build intelligent systems, …').
issues.recommended_fix: Replace footer tagline with a different sentence or remove.
files_likely_involved: index.html (and footer propagation across all pages)
